results.title: Luis Diaz and James Rodriguez headline Colombia World Cup squad
highlights:
Nestor Lorenzo has named his 26-man Colombia squad for the FIFA World Cup 2026.
[...]
Nestor Lorenzo has unveiled the 26-man squad for the FIFA World Cup 2026™, where Colombia will take on Congo DR, Portugal and Uzbekistan in Group K.
[...]
The Argentinian manager will have at his disposal the core of the squad that reached the final of the CONMEBOL Copa America two years ago — a feat they will aim to replicate in Canada, Mexico and the USA. After missing out on Qatar 2022, Colombia are chomping at the bit ahead of their return to the world’s biggest stage.
[...]
The squad is led by superstar Luis Diaz, who has enjoyed a sensational year at Bayern Munich, and James Rodriguez, the team captain and Colombia’s all-time leading scorer in the FIFA World Cup. James prepared for the global showpiece with a short-term move to Major League Soccer team Minnesota United.
[...]
Notably, Lorenzo has named nine midfielders to provide a number of attacking options during the tournament. "In tournaments like the World Cup, it is crucial to have options in the midfield; we aim to cover that area comprehensively," he said.
[...]

results.title: Colombia Manages Luis Diaz Minutes Ahead of Costa Rica Friendly
highlights:
Colombia Manages Luis Diaz Minutes Ahead of Costa Rica Friendly
[...]
# Colombia Manages Luis Diaz Minutes Ahead of Costa Rica Friendly
[...]
Colombia national football team manager Nestor Lorenzo is evaluating the workload of winger Luis Diaz ahead of the international friendly match against Costa Rica at the Nemesio Camacho El Campin Stadium in Bogota on Monday, June 1, 2026.
[...]
According to Futbolred, the coaching and medical staff are measuring Diaz's playing time because the forward has accumulated over 50 matches during his European club season. Additionally, the player is currently undergoing a physical adaptation process to the high altitude of the Colombian capital.
[...]
Contractual obligations for international exhibition matches typically require high-profile players to appear on the pitch, meaning Diaz is expected to play either a full or partial role. The physical evaluation also factors in the pitch conditions of El Campin, which forced the national squad to conduct training sessions at the Metropolitano de Techo Stadium instead.
[...]
If Diaz starts, the projected tactical lineup will feature goalkeeper Camilo Vargas, alongside central defenders Davinson Sanchez and Jhon Lucumi. Santiago Arias will cover the right flank due to Daniel Munoz's late arrival, while Deiver Machado takes the left side.
[...]
The midfield would consist of Richard Rios and Gustavo Puerta, who possesses previous altitude experience from his tenure with Bogota Futbol Club. The attacking unit would maintain a core of Jhon Arias, James Rodriguez, and Luis Suarez to build collective chemistry before their World Cup opener against Uzbekistan.
[...]
An alternative tactical plan places Diaz on the bench to test the squad's collective performance without him. In this configuration, Juan Camilo Portilla would join the midfield to slot between the central defenders, paired with Kevin Castano to handle transitions and distribution.
[...]
The adjusted frontline would introduce Carlos Andres Gomez as the right winger, moving James Rodriguez into an attacking midfielder position. Jhon Arias would then shift to the left wing to support center-forward Luis Suarez.
